what: The slot catalogue: every section a brief can carry, in document order. A slot is a function and a stable ID; the heading is the words the run writes over it and is recorded per run, never here. `spine: true` is the five sections every brief carries (D3). `default` is the heading that ships where the run has nothing better to say. `references/briefing-template.md` carries the same list in prose and says what each slot holds; `build/build.py` reconciles the two and raises where they disagree. `web` marks the slots the page carries (`references/brief-contract.md` Part 2): every page carries all six, in the page's order, and prints no heading over `map`, whose figure sits under Quick take. `web: false` slots, with `spine` and this list's order, are the retired format's; `build/build.py` and `tools/headings-check.sh` still read them, and W23 removes them.

slots.default: What They Say, What They Do
